text: Hades combines fast-paced hack-and-slash action with rich character storytelling in Greek mythology.
Some players complain about repetitive boss fights across extended playthroughs and finger strain.
Players praise the god boon combinations, voice acting, dynamic dialogue, and polished soundtrack.
A vast, atmospheric 2D metroidvania set in the ruined bug kingdom of Hallownest.
Critics and negative reviews point out punishing corpse-run walkbacks and lack of early direction.
Praised for intricate map exploration, tight nail combat, deep lore, and gorgeous hand-drawn art.
A rogue-lite, metroidvania-inspired action-platformer featuring frantic 2D combat and procedural levels.
Players note severe difficulty spikes on higher Boss Stem Cell levels and RNG weapon dependency.
Celebrated for lightning-fast responsive dodge rolls, weapon synergy diversity, and regular content updates.
Peaceful open-ended country-life RPG where players build their farm, raise animals, and befriend villagers.
Complaints mention slow early-game walking speed and stamina constraints during initial days.
Beloved for wholesome relaxing loop, endless secrets, community center milestones, and multiplayer.
2D sandbox adventure digging, building, and battling countless monsters across sprawling caverns.
Beginners struggle with the lack of an in-game tutorial and finding required progression guide steps.
Famed for immense depth of boss progression, limitless crafting freedom, and deep modding community.
A precision platformer about climbing Madeline's inner turmoil and the mystical Celeste Mountain.
Players find late-game B-sides and Farewell chapter screens extraordinarily punishing.
Acclaimed for Lena Raine's emotional soundtrack, instant respawns, empathetic mental health narrative, and assist mode.
An underwater open-world adventure game of oceanic exploration, survival craft, and alien ecology.
Common complaints include pop-in rendering bugs and extreme thalassophobia when entering the Void.
Universally praised for atmospheric tension, deep submersible crafting, biome design, and discovery.
A genre-defining roguelike deckbuilder where players draft relic synergies to defeat the Spire's heart.
Negative reviews lament harsh RNG card reward droughts on Ascension 20 runs.
Praised for mathematical balance, distinct character archetypes, emergent card synergies, and infinite replayability.
A hilarious first-person puzzle adventure featuring Aperture Science's portal gun and GLaDOS.
Some users feel the single-player campaign ends too quickly and desire more test chambers.
Renowned for Stephen Merchant and Ellen McLain's comedic writing, inventive cooperative campaign, and spatial puzzles.
A tactical multiplayer first-person shooter centered on bomb defusal and competitive round economy.
Frequent complaints cite cheaters, toxic matchmaking teammates, and smurfing in lower ranks.
Celebrated for crisp gun mechanics, tactical team communication, tournament esports scene, and skin trading.
A deeply complex 5v5 competitive MOBA where teams draft unique heroes to destroy the Ancient.
Criticized for an impenetrable new-player learning curve and severe teammate hostility.
Lauded for completely free unmonetized hero roster, tactical strategic depth, and high skill ceiling.
An open-world action-adventure RPG set in the dystopian megalopolis of Night City as mercenary V.
Historical launch glitches, pedestrian AI quirks, and vehicular handling received player criticism.
Adored for breathtaking neon visuals, Keanu Reeves as Johnny Silverhand, cinematic storytelling, and 2.0 perk overhaul.
A massive open-world souls-like action RPG directed by Hidetaka Miyazaki with worldbuilding by George R. R. Martin.
Players criticize delayed attack inputs, camera tracking on giant bosses, and late-game damage spikes.
Praised for staggering freedom of exploration, build variety, memorable legacy dungeons, and boss spectacle.
A story-rich party-based CRPG set in the D&D Forgotten Realms where player choices dictate fate.
Act 3 performance drops in the lower city and party inventory management clunkiness.
Hailed for unmatched narrative agency, rich companion romances, tactile turn-based combat, and voice acting.
